verdict.rationale: Mastra's own docs claim a searchable timeline of every model call, tool call, and handoff, plus run-level tracking of latency, cost, and tool usage. They also describe workflows with retries that a team can inspect, and Studio as a management interface. The evidence does not show that each step's inputs, outputs, retry attempts, and errors appear in that timeline, nor that the dashboard can be filtered, and nothing independent confirms it. Missing for 10: documented per-step input/output capture, per-step retry and error visibility in the timeline, filtering in the dashboard, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every run has a step-by-step timeline — inputs, outputs, retries, and errors per step — in a dashboard my team can search and filter

citations.quote: Inspect every model call, tool call, and handoff from one searchable timeline.
Track latency, cost, model calls, and tool usage across every production agent run.
Compose typed steps, retries, and branches into production workflows your team can inspect and ship.
Capture traces and user feedback into versioned datasets for repeatable evaluation.
